method: Fresh built-in GPT Image candidates from real special-stage palette native 8x + approved concept + WAIT/ROLL. limitations: Constant-velocity 60 Hz script previews plus positioned native-control capture; no all-layout route certification. Fixed variants are blue compatibility art, not the installed jade palette.

frames.prompt: Empty native sentinel preserved; no generation.

Fresh original MICA pangolin sprite, using image 1 native 8x as exact pose, image 2 identity sheet and image 3 approved playable frame as identity only. Stand still facing away, both shoes planted, compact head above short body. STRICT REAR VIEW. Small round ears, thin cream face edges high at head sides, jade scale dome, clear narrower torso, tapered scale tail separate from boots, white gloves and coral shoes. Match the actual 1994 Blue Sphere special-stage back-view rendering, NOT a modern illustrated sprite: deep hue-coloured one-pixel contour (deep jade, never black ink), solid shaded volume with 4 jade shade bands plus a small fifth pale glint, upper-left/front light, dark underside/right side, narrow faceted vertical highlights like native. No black internal scale borders, no thick cartoon outlines, no checkerboard dither (native uses contiguous shade clusters), no smooth airbrush. Large overlapping rounded scale plates must be suggested by shade transitions, NOT drawn with comic linework. Native uses only 9 visible colours (5 jade shades, white, sand-cream/tan, coral, dark sole); reuse coral for ear interior. Keep this native colour budget. The approved concept is IDENTITY only; its thick outline style must NOT be copied. Lock head and torso dimensions/placement against native. Back dome should be broad and compact, torso short, legs at exact native contacts. Pixel art with dense faceted surface shading, no vector/cel look. Use native pose width/height ratio, canvas and hotspots, one sprite, transparent background, no shadow/text. Candidate S2 with even simpler shade-defined scale rows and stronger native-like side shading.
